description: The controller's ACK base and bitmap for the seqs received from one box (one node, one epoch). Both controllers (simulator/atalaia_sim/field_controller.py AckTracker, used by the Pi; app/lib/controller/field_controller.dart AckTracker, the phone) must give exactly this ack_seq (65535 = 0xFFFF = nothing contiguous yet) and ack_bitmap (hex, bit n = ack_seq + 1 + n, trailing zero bytes dropped; null = no bitmap). 'received' lists inclusive [first, last] seq ranges in arrival order. Rule (decision SL-8): every seq more than 128 below the highest received counts as received, so a packet lost for good cannot stall the base.
